description: Save a day's check-in for one condition; it shows on that day's Day Card: severity 0-10, note, treatment_done. logged_on YYYY-MM-DD, default today in the user's time zone. One per condition per day: a second call that day changes only the fields it passes. ($0.05; API key required)

logged_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today in the user's time zone.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

treatment_done.description: What they did for it that day.

name: log_condition_checkin

checkin.description: checkin_id, condition_id, condition_name, logged_on, severity, note, treatment_done.

created.description: false: that day already had a check-in, and only the fields passed changed.

idempotent_replay.description: true when this request_id already ran: the first result, nothing new written.

title: Condition Check-in
